children: Overview
Canada food infrastructure equipment maker's Q3 revenue fell 13% yr/yr, slightly missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA for Q3 dropped 45% yr/yr to C$39 mln, margin declined to 11.5%
Commercial segment weakness and Brazil project issues weighed on results, while Farm segment improved
Outlook
AGI's total order book was $432 mln at Sept 30, 2026, down 35% YOY
Farm order book increased YOY, led by North America where it more than doubled
Company says Commercial activity remains soft across most regions
Result Drivers

COMMERCIAL SEGMENT WEAKNESS - Commercial revenue and profitability fell due to the wind-down of Brazil Long-Term Financed Projects, challenging market conditions in EMEA and APAC, and softer North American demand
BRAZIL IMPACTS - Nearly half of the Commercial Adjusted EBITDA decline was due to Brazil, including increased cost estimates for remaining projects and C$5.4 mln in bad debt expense
FARM SEGMENT GROWTH - Farm revenue rose 19% and Adjusted EBITDA increased 38%, helped by stronger North American demand and improved dealer inventory levels
